Problem stem: Consider $h(x) = \begin{cases} \dfrac{\sin(3x)}{x} & x \neq 0 \\ 3 & x = 0 \end{cases}$. Is $h$ continuous at $x = 0$?
Available first step: Compute the limit of sin(3x)/x as x approaches 0 using the known limit sin(u)/u → 1.
